items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Gene Krupa as part of the original trio with Teddy Wilson and Lionel Hampton; Interviewee does not mention Gene Krupa in their response.

ctx.x: I think that’s him, Teddy Wilson.
Oh yeah. He was in the original trio with Gates – [Lionel] Hampton – and Gene Krupa. So that’s Teddy Wilson, right.

Yeah, he was on there. So John Hammond had been trying to convince Benny that I was the second Charlie Christian. Benny Goodman was, “No. You’ll never be Charlie Christian.” You know how he talked, the way he talked. So they let me come on the show, and we were doing Seven Come Eleven [Benson sings the melody]. I was happy. I said, oh man, I’m sitting in for Charlie Christian here. The guys in the band, I noticed they were very quiet, because during that era, Benny Goodman was considered a tyrant. So they…
